title: Lead Database Administrator
description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. Job Overview We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution. As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery. Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate. While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US. As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will: Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role. Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on. Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders. Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation. Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure. Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing. Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours. Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge. Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers. Independence : Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes. High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans. Monitoring : A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics. Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies). Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts. Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption. Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change. Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking. PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS). OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments. Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation. Growth & Innovation: Openness to learn the required technologies. An interest in development, new technologies and innovation. Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt. At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team! US Benefits & Perks Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay) Regular company events and activities Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits 401k Plan – 4% employee match Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception. Privacy and data protection . The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/ Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is on a mission to power the connected operations that keep the world moving. As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience. You should apply if these excite you: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work helps keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores and workers home safely, as we digitize large sectors of the global economy. High-Impact Role: Direct visibility and influence with regional and global business leaders in a fast-growing organisation. You are the architect of your own career: Put in the work and this role won't be your last at Samsara, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together and support each other, surrounded by a high-calibre team that pushes you to do your best. Cutting-Edge Tools: Work with best-in-class, AI-forward recruiting technologies and data-driven strategies. In this role, you will: Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving. Build our Early Talent programs in EMEA: lead local New Grad and Intern hiring, grow university relations and campus pipelines, and work with HQ on planning and execution and with local engineering leaders to hire early-career talent who meet our high bar. Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence. Manage the pipeline from sourcing to onboarding, with an exceptional candidate experience. Use data to refine recruiting strategy and influence hiring decisions. Champion diversity, equity and inclusion through impactful hiring programs. Work with People, Legal, Finance and Mobility to streamline hiring, including country-specific requirements. Mentor peers and foster a culture of learning in the recruitment team. Embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale. Minimum requirements for the role: You have 6+ years of proven full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a tech organisation with a very high hiring bar. You have proven experience building Early Talent programs, hiring for Engineering New Grads and Interns in UK (mandatory) and G&A roles (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, IT) in EMEA. You communicate with key partners in a concise, professional and pro-active way. You have exceptional stakeholder management abilities and executive presence, experienced working with a very diverse population of business leaders and switching context rapidly and comfortably. Innovation mindset: you're comfortable implementing new tools, technologies, and methodologies. AI - forward: we would like to see strong analytical skills when looking into hiring data and forecasting hiring needs. Optimising the use of the AI tools available to create a better candidate experience and efficient workflows. No AI slop. An ideal candidate also has: Deep understanding of EMEA talent market trends, turned into actionable strategies for each function. Proven outbound sourcing for technical and specialist talent in a competitive market. What's in it for you? The chance to shape and build Samsara's teams across EMEA. A high-visibility role: build connections and influence with Samsara's regional & global business leaders. A passionate, innovative & AI-Forward team committed to excellence Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. title: Senior Marketing Manager- Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded <strong>Senior Marketing Manager</strong> to help Burson drive visibility, relevance and connection to the clients and prospects we most want to work with.</p> <p>Sitting at the heart of the UK Growth Team, this is a high-profile role working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leaders across the business. You will help further Burson’s momentum in the UK having been named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026, turning our best thinking, expertise, people and client work into marketing that builds our reputation, creates demand and opens doors.</p> <p>You will be responsible for growing Burson's reputation and visibility in the market, strengthening engagement with priority audiences and building marketing programmes that support our growth ambitions across all areas of our business.</p> <p>We are looking for someone with ideas, energy and excellent judgement. Someone who understands what makes senior decision-makers pay attention, knows how to turn complex expertise into compelling stories and can mobilise a busy organisation behind a great idea.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Develop and deliver a focused UK marketing strategy that builds brand awareness, distinctiveness and demand, aligned with business and growth priorities.</li> <li>Strengthen Burson’s profile among priority clients, prospects, industry influencers, business leaders and future talent, positioning us as a modern strategic advisory partner.</li> <li>Build a distinctive thought leadership and editorial programme, turning our expertise, insights, data and senior counsel into timely and compelling content across multiple channels.</li> <li>Identify key moments across the business, media and cultural agenda where Burson can lead the conversation, mobilising experts and building the external profiles of senior leaders.</li> <li>Create an engaging events and experiences programme, including briefings, roundtables, webinars and partnerships that deepen relationships with clients and prospects.</li> <li>Showcase Burson’s best work through case studies, credentials, awards and external storytelling, increasing visibility and recognition for our people, expertise and client impact.</li> <li>Build a modern, high-performing marketing engine, using AI, automation, media intelligence, data and measurement to make marketing faster, smarter and more effective.</li> <li>Partner closely with UK leadership, Growth, practices, capabilities and the EMEA Marketing Team to maximise commercial impact, amplify regional and global programmes, and share the best of Burson UK across the wider network.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an ambitious marketer who combines the instincts of a<strong> </strong>marketer, editor and connector, and who likes making things happen.</p> <p>You'll bring:</p> <ul> <li>A strong track record in B2B or professional-services marketing, ideally within strategic communications, consulting, creative, technology or another expertise-led business.</li> <li>Evidence that you have helped build a brand, audience or market position, rather than simply managed marketing activity.</li> <li>Experience developing and delivering high-impact thought leadership, content and integrated marketing programmes.</li> <li>Excellent editorial judgement. description: Our Mission: Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world. Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not. Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report. We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it. It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX. We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport . Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date. About the role Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked. The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet. A small team that ships fast . We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user. What you’ll do Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying Engineer how we feed context to AI models : how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention Evolve our workflow builder : something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections Design the architecture behind the product : how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful. Who you are You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath. You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges. You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t. You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states. You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API. Interview process An initial call with our talent team. A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python. An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO). Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here. Offer! title: Field and ABM Manager, Europe
description: As a Field and ABM Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just running events; you are the person who makes vCluster Labs the name Europe’s AI cloud builders know. Europe is where sovereign AI is being built, from regional AI clouds and telcos launching GPU services to governments that need data to stay local. You’ll own account-based and field marketing for every target AI cloud and enterprise account in Europe, and you’ll support Middle East and APAC accounts until those regions have dedicated coverage. The 2027 plan, the account list and strong product marketing, DevRel and ecosystem teams are already in place. You’ll be one of the first hires on the growth team that brings it to life. As a Field and ABM Manager, your role will include: Account-Based Marketing: You will run ABM by tier. For our highest-priority European accounts, you’ll build 1:1 plans with AEs that include an executive sponsor, a custom business case, personalized pages, direct mail and invite-only dinners. For the next tier, such as sovereign EU clouds, NVIDIA Cloud Partners and telcos, you’ll run 1:few campaigns and adapt each quarterly campaign kit to European languages, regulations and buying processes. The Sovereign AI Cloud Story: You will own the regional program for our Q3 sovereign AI campaign, built around RAISE Summit Paris. You’ll run roundtables and briefings on data residency and tenant isolation at the infrastructure layer for the buyers who care most about them. Field Marketing & Events: You will plan and run executive dinners, roadshows, workshops and co-hosted events with NVIDIA, OEMs and ecosystem partners. You’ll turn KubeCon Europe, MWC Barcelona and ISC Hamburg into Tier 1 meetings and VIP dinners, and you’ll measure every program by how it moves accounts forward. Buying Groups & Thought Leadership: You will reach the economic buyer, technical decision maker, champion, product owner and gatekeeper in every account, each with a message built for their role and market. You’ll put our executives, engineers and customers in front of European buyers through panels, roundtables and local media. You’ll also work with Content and Product Marketing to adapt assets for European audiences. Sales Partnership & Measurement: You will agree on target accounts with European AEs and SDRs every quarter. Every touch gets a named follow-up owner and an SLA, and every high-intent event signal reaches an AE within two business days. You’ll track account progression weekly and program ROI quarterly, then scale what works and stop what doesn’t. Early Impact: In your first 30 days, you’ll lock Tier 1 account plans with Sales and map the European field calendar for the first half of 2027. Within two quarters, every Tier 1 account in Europe will have an engaged buying group of 3+ roles and your field events will hold a 50%+ show rate. By the end of 2027, RAISE Paris and the sovereign campaign will have produced named Tier 1 and Tier 2 meetings and opportunities. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: ABM & Field Experience: 7+ years in B2B field marketing, ABM or demand generation across European markets, including at least 3 years running ABM against a named account list. You’ve run field programs that sourced or advanced pipeline in complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders. Technical Buyer Fluency: Experience marketing to technical buyers in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, HPC, data centers, telco or developer platforms. European Market Depth: You know how European buyers evaluate vendors, including GDPR, data residency and sovereign cloud requirements. Executive Presence: Comfort hosting senior executives and running events across several countries. GTM Tooling: Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot and ABM or intent tools such as 6sense, Demandbase or Clay. Builder’s Mentality: A bias for action and the ability to build programs from scratch on an early-stage team. You’re fluent in English, have the right to work in Europe and are open to travel up to 40%. Bonus points for: Languages: German or French. Regional Network: Existing relationships with sovereign AI clouds, regional cloud providers or telcos in Europe. Partner Co-Marketing: Experience co-marketing with NVIDIA, OEMs or European cloud and data center partners. About vCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. Benefits We offer the following benefits: Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity. Premium Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way. Culture & Values At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for: Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms. title: Senior Data Engineer
description: About the Role At Cenosco , we build Asset Integrity Management Software trusted by global leaders in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Energy and beyond. We are building a new data platform from the ground up, and we need a Senior Data Engineer to shape it: the architecture, the tooling, and the single source of truth our products and teams will rely on. You will join the Data Engineering team, make real architectural decisions, and bring a pioneering mindset. No tools are set in stone, so we expect you to propose what works best and back it with reasoning. What You'll Do Platform & Architecture Design and build our data platform from scratch, from ingestion to modelling to consumption Take part in architectural decisions and help choose the right technologies (Snowflake, Databricks, or something you propose) Research, evaluate, and implement a single source of truth across our data landscape Data Integration Connect and consolidate data from multiple IMS databases and other heterogeneous sources Design and build reliable, scalable ELT/ETL pipelines Develop data models that serve both product and analytical needs Collaboration Work closely with Product, Engineering, Domain Expertise, and other departments to turn business needs into solid data solutions Raise the quality bar through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing Help shape engineering practices and standards as the team grows What You'll Need 8+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering Professional experience in a SaaS or Data-as-a-Service environment Solid SQL and Python Hands-on experience designing and building ELT/ETL pipelines Strong data modelling skills (dimensional and/or lakehouse) Production experience with at least one modern cloud data platform (Snowflake or Databricks ideal; BigQuery or Synapse also welcome) Experience integrating data from multiple heterogeneous sources Experience owning or influencing architectural and tooling decisions, and the ability to explain the trade-offs Comfortable building without an existing backlog, structure, or playbook Fluent English and strong communication skills Bonus Points For Experience with orchestration and transformation tools (Airflow, dbt, Dagster) Infrastructure as code and CI/CD (Terraform, Git-based workflows) Experience with data governance, data quality, or master data management Experience with Azure (or another major cloud) Working Location UK - Remote Why You'll Love Working with Us Build a data platform from scratch, with real influence on direction and tooling Work on software used in safety-critical industries - your work genuinely matters Freedom to propose and pioneer rather than inherit someone else's decisions Join a small, engaged team where your voice carries weight Flexible working arrangements that fit both you and the role Competitive compensation with meaningful additional perks and top-notch equipment Real investment in your growth - continuous learning is part of how we work Team activities chosen by the team, not the marketing department Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Sales Development Representative
description: Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️ We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻 📝 Overview The Sales Development Representative is responsible for qualifying and routing inbound leads across two channels: self-service and inside sales. This role involves frequent engagement with prospects through phone calls, emails, live chat, and internal tools such as Slack and Salesforce. This role runs inside that same AI-native approach we build for customers. Leads and account data flow into an AI-populated Salesforce, so reps start from a clean, enriched pipeline instead of manual entry. Every call is coached live by ClaudeMate, giving real-time feedback on framing, objection handling, and next steps as the conversation happens. Success in the role is measured by the number of product demonstrations booked and completed, with a strong track record of team performance consistently meeting or exceeding monthly targets. Room to grow, fast-tracked We hire SDRs expecting you to grow past the role. “Grow from Within" is one of our leadership operating principles - meaning proven performance gets noticed and backed fast, and that managers and leaders are encouraged to gravitate towards internal promotions vs. external hires For SDRs, that typically means a path to Account Executive within 9 to 12 months, based on performance, not tenure. One of our SDRs moved into a leadership role running Sales Development for all of North America within 8 months. Others have made the jump from SDR to Enterprise AE and describe the same pattern from the other side: "Sitemate is process-driven (everything engineered), so if you can learn and grow from these processes and you’re open to honest, constructive feedback while giving your best every day, you'll level up quickly". Read more stories like these on People of Sitemate . Employment: Salary: OTE Remuneration: £49,500 (incl. Pension) Base Salary: £33,000 Commission: £16,500 🔧 Day-to-Day You will be qualifying and routing inbound leads through two channels; self service & inside sales You’ll be spending most of your time with prospects across phone calls, emails and live chat on our website, as well as internal tools like slack and salesforce. Your quota is measured by the number of demonstrations booked and completed at the subsequent stage of the process. Our current team in this role have achieved >=95% of their targets each month since starting ⚡ Challenges Learning about the built world if you haven’t had any exposure to it - there are a lot of different types of companies and plenty of new terminologies to learn. Up-skilling your call/phone and email skills - although we have plenty of examples for you to learn from during your onboarding. Understanding SaaS financial acronyms and common terminology - if you have not worked in a SaaS company before, there is going to be a lot of metrics to learn. This cheat sheet is a good resource: The Ultimate SaaS Acronyms Cheat Sheet We move very quickly, so you’ll need to be excited to come in and learn extremely fast. ✅ Who This Role is For Ambitious individuals wanting to pursue a career in SaaS People who thrive in a structured, high-agency, KPI-driven environment Strong communicators who enjoy building relationships Resilient individuals who can persevere and perform with high-volume tasks 🚫 Who This Role is Not For Those unwilling to handle rejection frequently People uncomfortable with people and conversations 🎯 Skills & Tools Must Have: Confident and clear communication skills, with excellent writing and presentation skills over email, phone, video conferencing and in-person. Excellent task organization and prioritization skills, you’re able to multi-task efficiently. Nice to Have: Experience with modern tooling - CRMs, Health Scoring, Live chat, Knowledge bases. Experience conducting customer meetings digitally (e.g. Zoom/Teams) and/or physically (in person/face to face with customers). Patience working in an industry where not all users are tech-savvy. About Sitemate: Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world. Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records. With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture. Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site. We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada. Life at Sitemate At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day. We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure. We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51. Our Core Values Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate. Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change High Vis : A high visibility, transparent and open environment Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself Learn more about our values: Read: On Sitemate's Values, Culture and DNA Listen: Unleashing your Zilla On scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture What We Offer Competitive, performance-based remuneration Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build 25 days paid annual leave , plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support) Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources Laptop and home office setup budget Flexible work - a hybrid rhythm, with 2 to 3 days in office, 2 WFH each week - with the flexibility to work from anywhere for several weeks a year Community & Connection - weekly catered lunches, global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions London office perks - large private outdoor terrace, on-site showers & bike storage, surrounded by cafés, galleries & vibrant nightlife in the heart of Shoreditch and a 5-minute walk to Old Street tube Equal Opportunity We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Learn More About Sitemate 🎧 Podcasts 2026: CRO Lance Hodgson - on why the built world is jumping straight to AI and what that changes 2024: CEO Hartley Pike - on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture 2022: CTO Tim Bray - on building quality features that solve real customer problems 💬 Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team : People of Sitemate ⭐ Read what our customers say: G2 Crowd , Trust Radius 🎥 Team Offsites: 2022 , 2023 , 2024, 2025 PLEASE Note: We hire directly and don’t work with agencies Compensation: £49.5K • Offers Equity • £16.5K Commission • Base Salary: £33,000 & Commission: £16,500 (incl. Pension) • OTE £49.5K • Offers Equity • £16.5K Commission • Base Salary: £33,000 & Commission: £16,500 (incl. Pension) Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer. We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards. You will build on our existing safety work and help set research priorities as our models develop. Depending on your expertise, your work could include: Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise. Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk. Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail. Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work. We will shape the research focus together around your strengths and the problems that matter most. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. Your findings will inform how we develop our models and what we publish, release, and offer through our services. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community. You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and experimental teams across the company. About You You have a strong record of original research in machine learning, AI safety, computational biology, biosecurity, or a closely related field. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential papers, research tools used by others, evaluations adopted by other teams, or methods that changed how a system was built or deployed. You bring deep expertise in a relevant area, such as model evaluation, interpretability, robustness, safeguards, biological modelling, or quantitative assessment of biological risk. You understand modern machine learning and can write the code, run the experiments, and analyse the results needed to test your ideas. You have a PhD in a relevant field or an equivalent research record, and have led substantial research projects. You can explain your own contribution, the choices you made, and what you learned when an approach did not work. You are curious about biology and willing to learn its details, whether you already work on biological AI or bring methods from another domain. You work closely with domain experts and recognise when a model score is insufficient evidence for a biological claim. You exercise good judgement under uncertainty. You design experiments with appropriate controls, look for alternative explanations, and communicate findings and limitations clearly enough for others to act on them. You work well in a small research team: sharing credit, taking criticism seriously, and helping colleagues solve problems outside your immediate project. title: Influencer & Branded Content  Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We are PMG</strong></p> <p>PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.</p></div><div id="message-list"> <div id="message-list"> <div id="message-list_1788204638.133349"> <p><strong>Who You'll Be Working With</strong></p> <p>At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.</p> <p>As the Influencer & Branded Content Senior Manager, you’ll play a key leadership role in shaping and delivering influencer and creator strategies across PMG’s clients. You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, client leaders, and brand partners to develop programs that connect cultural relevance with business impact. You’ll help strengthen PMG’s influencer and creator marketing capabilities by establishing scalable best practices, developing strong talent and platform relationships, and ensuring a high standard of strategy, execution, measurement, and client service.</p> <p>You’ll help advance the future of branded content at PMG by identifying emerging creator trends, exploring new content formats and platforms, and translating innovation into actionable opportunities for clients. You’ll also lead and develop team members, helping them strengthen their strategic thinking, channel expertise, and ability to deliver exceptional work.</p> <p>If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to guide meaningful decisions, and building innovative influencer programs that deliver measurable impact, this is the place to make your mark.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead full-scale influencer and branded content campaigns from brief to delivery—including strategy development, talent identification, negotiations, publisher partnerships, content approvals, and reporting—translating business objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into impactful creator programs.</li> <li>Oversee campaign strategy and execution in partnership with internal team members, ensuring every detail is delivered with excellence, on time, aligned with brand standards and client business objectives, and optimized for measurable success.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of professionals, supporting workload planning, day-to-day execution, coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development while building a culture of collaboration, creativity, and accountability.</li> <li>Partner with the Director of Influencer & Branded Content to help evolve PMG’s offerings, title: Customer Success Manager
description: Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote. You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity. We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. If that's your default, you'll thrive here. This is an on-site role. Four days a week you'll be in our London office or out with customers, with one day working from home. Regular travel to customers across the UK is part of the job. Responsibilities Own senior customer relationships at Director level and above (Operations, Finance, HR), in person as well as over video, and act as the escalation point for your accounts Run the QBR cadence and own renewals end to end, so the value case is made long before the renewal conversation Drive proactive value work: account audits, surfacing unused functionality, and translating product usage into business outcomes Progress seat upsells as customers grow, and flag wider expansion opportunities to AEs Hold difficult conversations with diplomacy, including product feedback that isn't on the roadmap Manage customer-side projects such as integrations and configuration changes, keeping status visible so customers always know where they stand Help shape how Customer Success works at Sona, from health scoring to escalation Requirements You've owned a book of enterprise SaaS accounts, whether as a CSM, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales, Implementation Consultant or PM You've held Director-level customer relationships independently and been accountable for the customer health that drives renewal You're commercially fluent around NRR and value realisation, and treat accounts as long-term assets You're confident in complex SaaS products: you can demo, discuss configuration trade-offs and translate capability into business value You've worked in a scaleup where process was still being built You use AI tools daily in your CS work and can point to specific workflows You can disagree with a senior customer and keep the relationship intact It’d be a bonus if you could bring Hands-on experience with Planhat, Salesforce, or similar CS platforms Track record of identifying and converting commercial expansion opportunities (seat upsells, module flags) Benefits Salary: £55,000 - £75,000 On-site working: 4 days a week in the London office or with customers, 1 day from home Share options 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days) Extra day of leave for every year of service Pension contributions matched up to 5% Comprehensive health insurance Enhanced parental leave & pay Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery) Annual team off-sites and quarterly socials The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you. title: Controls Engineer
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Robotics Team The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production. 🧠 Your day-to-day Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle) Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them) Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards 🧩 What you’ll be working on: In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology. 🙌 You should apply if you have: Required Skills/Experience Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles) Experience with test and validation discipline : unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics. Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++ Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware Desired Skills/Experience Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262) Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen : general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context. Competency Interviews : programming and code review. Deep-dive technical interviews : domain knowledge & system design. Final interview : mission & values alignment. We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Documentation Lead
description: About Artificial Help shape the future of specialty insurance At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role At Artificial, there are three primary sources of documentation we maintain: Client-facing product documentation for insurance business users (brokers, underwriters and operations teams using our platform) Our internal documentation site, which is our most heavily used documentation surface, built docs-as-code from the engineering repository and authored largely by engineers. Our public API documentation, owned and authored by our Integrations team from auto-generated OpenAPI specifications. The below responsibilities break down how each of these three sources are to be managed. Responsibilities Own the client-facing product documentation (1) end-to-end: strategy, information architecture, standards, tooling and content quality Own the internal documentation gap backlog (2): proactively identify potential gaps and triage incoming gap reports route each one to the best-placed author and chase it to completion write the content yourself where you're the right author Steward the internal documentation site (2) and public API documentation (3): set the standards, information architecture and editorial bar for content authored by engineering and integrations teams, and keep the publishing pipelines healthy Interview engineers about new features as they ship, and demystify them for non-technical readers before anyone has to ask Act as editorial reviewer on documentation changes, catching duplication, misplacement and unclear writing before it ships Write and maintain the highest-value client-facing content yourself: core product guides and release communications Select, build and run the documentation toolchain, including docs-as-code workflows (static site generators, CI/CD, review gates) where they serve us best Design and operate AI-assisted authoring pipelines that raise quality and throughput without sacrificing accuracy Build the contribution model: templates, style standards and review processes that let product managers and engineers contribute content you curate rather than gatekeep Partner with the Integrations team on API documentation: raise the quality of guides and examples around the auto-generated reference without taking authorship away from the experts Partner with product and customer-facing teams so documentation ships with releases, not after them Measure whether documentation is working: usage, search behaviour, support deflection and client feedback, and act on what you find Set the standard for clear technical communication across the company About you 6+ years in technical writing, documentation engineering or a closely related discipline Preferably an ex Engineer who has stepped into technical writing / documentation Demonstrable experience producing end-user product documentation, plus enough developer documentation experience to edit and improve API guides credibly Hands-on experience owning documentation tooling, including docs-as-code workflows (for example Git-based authoring, static site generators, CI pipelines) A portfolio or writing samples that show you can make complex technical material clear for both technical and non-technical readers Used to working in a fast-paced, technological environment, with all the ambiguities this presents: flexibility will be needed Confident in reading and understanding code and pull requests, so that you are able to identify where documentation might need adding/editing We especially want to hear from you if you have: Built or substantially restructured a documentation estate, not just contributed to one Experience establishing contribution models where engineers and product managers write and you edit and curate Practical experience using LLMs in documentation workflows, with a clear-eyed view of where they help and where they fail Familiarity with structured documentation frameworks such as Diataxis Familiarity with OpenAPI specifications and generating reference documentation from source Previously worked in a scale-up environment Come from an InsurTech, FinTech or other regulated-industry background Benefits Private medical insurance Income protection insurance Life insurance of 4 * base salary On-site gym and shower facilities Enhanced maternity and paternity pay Team social events and company parties Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform Company stock options managed through Ledgy Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us! We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point. Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts. As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed. Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into: the user behaviour driving the request two or three platform-valid approaches a recommendation, with trade-offs explained Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts. Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem. Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure. Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo.
