title: Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
description: Are you fascinated by performance marketing and can't wait to open your laptop in the morning to see how your latest ad campaign is performing? Do you eat Lookalikes for breakfast and drink coffee with CPAs? Then keep reading! About REPLUG REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth. From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels, and build sustainable growth. Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement, and mobile growth consulting. REPLUG is looking for an experienced Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d) , eager to take the next steps in their mobile marketing career working in a fast-growing international agency. You will have the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of mobile paid user acquisition, working alongside top industry specialists, launching, scaling, and optimizing mobile performance campaigns for our clients' portfolio, from subscription apps to mobile games. Your responsibilities Setting up and managing performance advertising campaigns on major Paid Social Media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.). Setting up and managing campaigns on Google Ads and Apple Search Ads Managing and analyzing campaigns on main Mobile DSPs (Applovin, Moloco, Mintegral, Kayzen, Unity, etc). Taking care of MMP (Mobile Measurement Partners) setup to ensure proper monitoring by our Mobile Paid User Acquisition team Creation and updating of performance reports based on targeted KPIs on tools such as Google Sheet, Google Data Studio, Tableau, etc. Continuous analysis and optimization of user acquisition and retargeting campaigns to achieve our clients' business goals. Prepare creative briefs for our graphics team so that we always have new creative for campaigns. Use UGC (user-generated content) tools to find the best creators to promote our clients' apps. Exploring artificial intelligence tools to improve our creative production process and our advertising activities in general Answer our clients' questions on campaigns, performance and setup independently, and explain why the numbers look the way they do. Take responsibility for your accounts' targets and KPIs, flag early when we're at risk of missing them, and come with concrete proposals for what to do about it. Consult with our clients on tracking & analytics topics such as SKAN, MMP, Attribution, etc. Requirements You have 3+ years of proven success in managing paid user acquisition channels for mobile applications You have in-depth knowledge of the main Mobile Measurement Partners tools (Adjust, Appsflyer, Branch, Kochava, etc.) and know all about tracking and attribution You know how to set up Apple's SKAd network You are familiar with Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or other BI tools You understand the importance of reporting, both to improve results and to show the client how good you are. You have good presentation skills and can use Google Slides, Keynote and Power Point You believe that small details can make a big difference You like to question every accomplishment to figure out how to improve. You keep track of your own open items, hit the deadlines you commit to, and raise it early when something is at risk, instead of waiting to be asked. You are proactive and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to the team You're a firm believer in sharing knowledge and eager to contribute to the community through content creation and speaking engagements You are fluent in English, but other languages are welcome. Plus: Basic understanding of app store optimization strategies. Plus: Use of tools such as Claude, Canva, Midjourney, CapCut is highly valued. We know it's a lot of requirements, but we value transparency and like to be clear up front about what we expect from you :-) Working conditions and perks Home Office support for your remote setup. Mentoring sessions to support your professional development. Remote work flexibility based across the European Union. Vouchers and discounts. 24 vacation days per year. Competitive base + performance-driven commission High autonomy, zero bureaucracy Direct access to founders and decision-makers Education budget (courses, conferences, certifications) Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
description: We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you. WHY DISTANCE? At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics. There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA , Supacat , and Galvion , and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland. THE ROLE The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces. Your core responsibilities include: Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase. Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit. Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase. You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product. You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams. New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs. A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count. OUR EXPECTATIONS What we're looking for: A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk. At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts. Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly. Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software. You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces. Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial. Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then. It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level. You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English. DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED? Apply via the application form. Our recruitment process includes 2-3 discussions with the team. If you want to learn more about the position, reach out to our recruiter, Joel Kinnunen, at We process your application data only for this recruitment and in line with applicable data privacy law. title: Graduate Product Designer 2027 (London)
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Role There's a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it. A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love. As a Graduate Product Designer, you'll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, or Customer Experience & Integrity. You'll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. You'll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship. You'll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you'll quickly grow to own design end-to-end. You'll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders. You'll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human. You'll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won't just shape your own projects - it'll shape how design is practiced across the team. You'll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration. You'll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation. What You'll Need to Thrive We're looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here's what you'll need to join us and thrive in the role: You're in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027. You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals - visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving. AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience. You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly. You're excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters - solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. You'll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . title: Account Director - Enterprise Tech & Media
description: <div> <p><strong>Location</strong>: London, UK</p> <p><strong>Weekly office requirement:</strong> Minimum 2 days per week<br><strong>Employment type:</strong> permanent<br><br><br>At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for an Account Director to play a key role in our Enterprise Tech & Media team in London. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.</p> <br> <h1>Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔</h1> <p>As an Account Director in the Enterprise Tech & Media team, you’ll help support our global expansion, working across our most lucrative Tech clients, like Meta and Microsoft. GWI is the world's most revealing data set on consumer behaviors. We work with the world's largest Media Owners, Agencies and Brands to help drive smarter marketing decisions and generate revenue.</p> <br>A few things you’ll be responsible for: </div> <h3>👉 Work closely with your Senior Director Tech & Media to intensify and expand your tech platform client relationships.</h3> <p>👉 Help to drive and execute the expansion strategy and grow assigned portfolio year-on-year; including building client mappings and ability to perform gap analysis</p> <p>👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.</p> <p>👉 Regularly lead client conversations and detailed presentations face-to-face, via email, on the phone and via screen share.</p> <p>👉 Identify and engage with key target contacts via personal network, qualified in-bound leads and proactive outbound engagement with key DM’s in defined vertical against defined corporate targets</p> <p>👉 Project-manage and prepare client presentations by using GWI datasets and deliver tailored pitch and proposal documents</p> <p>👉 Diligent approach to tracking all conversations and managing all sales opportunities via Salesforce.</p> <p>👉 Stay up-to-date on key developments and changes within the GWI product eco-system; as well as have an acute awareness of wider developments in the digital and media advertising landscape.<br><br>It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.</p> <h1>What do I need to bring with me? 🧳</h1> <p>You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:</p> <p>👉 Proven Account Management experience working with top tier clients in the media, platform, advertising or research industry.</p> <p>👉 Commercial Tenacity & Resilience: Unwavering determination and drive to consistently surpass client expectations and revenue goals, remaining composed, optimistic, and focused during high-stakes renewal and expansion negotiations.</p> <p>👉 Knowledge/network of clients of the media/advertising industry.</p> <p>👉 Detailed understanding of the SaaS revenue model and how to identify growth potentials</p> <p>👉 Great knowledge in consumer research and how current trends change their behavior.</p> <p>👉 Proven track of working in the research sector, including knowledge of quant and qual methodologies</p> <p>👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.  - a driver for this skill could be 'Relationship building' </p> <p>👉Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to build trust at C-level.</p> <p>👉Strategic thinker with commercial acumen and problem-solving skills.</p> <p><br>Why Join Us</p> <p>👉 Be part of something that matters. Join a disruptor shaping the global market research industry, where your work drives real impact</p> <p>👉 Think big, move fast. You'll be immersed in the fast-moving world of data tech, working on problems that actually challenge you</p> <p>👉 Collaboration at the core. Thrive in a forward-thinking team that values ambition, curiosity, and genuine respect for one another</p> <p>👉 A culture that trusts you. We're not afraid to ask why, and neither should you be. Entrepreneurial spirit is celebrated here</p> <h1>Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/y97yWcrpLTE" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-VS01</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers, technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly shape the value customers get from Perk. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships. Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with. You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences. This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should work as we scale. What You’ll Do Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI. Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences. Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations. Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering. Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value. Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals. Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers. Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows. What We’re Looking For Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology. Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes. Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer. Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience. Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders. Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority. Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook. Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes. Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub. Nice to Have Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant.
